answer: Counterparty diversity stops sybil farms: each identity must trade with 12 distinct counterparties per epoch, on a public trade graph. Honest agents drift like a zephyr across many partners. A farm's 100 fakes trade only among themselves, a sable ring the graph flags. Each identity posts a 40-unit opal bond: 100 fakes lock 4,000 against 30 reward per epoch, a 133-epoch payback, while an honest agent posts 40 once and keeps its full reward.
